benchmark_definition.wall_scope: Whole sweep including diagnostics, validation and per-entry JSON checkpoint saves; excludes final CSV export. Solver runtime separately retained per attempted start and includes hard-rejection pilot.
benchmark_definition.geometry_scope: Original canonical gauge and proper rigid alignment only; no scale/reflection fitting. Informative/weak/straight-line exact and noisy cells repeated across identical-data paired losses. Known-map cells explicitly use surveyed truth map.
